question: Can THREE components (R75 sense-de-bulge + U18 fanout + ONE support/divider part) reach U18 8/8 AND close the western BAT_PROTECTED_P trunk R75.2->U11.2?
verdict: U18 8/8 ACHIEVED (first reproducible) BUT western BPP trunk STILL OPEN

runs.note: FIRST reproducible U18 8/8 (open none). target bit 8 BAT_PROTECTED_P R75.2->U11.2 = FALSE.
U18 west 3.5 seals U18.7; trunk still open.
smaller R79 step +0.5; U18.7 open; trunk still open.
U18 east 4.5 seals U18.7; trunk still open.

u18_8of8_result.detail: The e10n north pose at the MID U18 x (4.0) is the unique fan-8 basin center; nudging U18 west (3.5) or east (4.5) re-opens U18.7. So U18 8/8 is real but knife-edge -- a single 0.5 mm x-shift drops it back to 7/8.

invariant_casualty.detail: target bit 8 is FALSE in ALL four cardinality-3 runs, including the 8/8 primary. Cardinality 3 solved the U18 fanout casualty (8/8 at the primary pose) but did NOT close the western BPP trunk. The R79-east lever widened the analytic B.Cu corridor from 0.40 to 0.80 mm -- real, but below the 1.20 mm floor -- and the real arbiter's F.Cu current-escape staging did not convert 0.80 mm into a routed trunk.

analytic_cross_check.model: place_search_c3_002z.trunk_best_w (graded: largest B.Cu inflation at which R75.2->D9.1 routes with the full 8-pin fanout laid)
analytic_cross_check.result: c2 e10n base = 0.40 mm; c3 R79-east winner = 0.80 mm; both < 1.20 mm floor. Calibrated against the supervised runs: the 0.80 mm corridor is real but sub-floor, exactly matching the still-open trunk in every real run.
analytic_cross_check.conclusion: the analytic prefilter is trustworthy for the western BPP trunk casualty. Cardinality 3 (divider family) is marginal and exhausted below the floor.

implication: Cardinality 3 delivers the first reproducible U18 8/8 but cannot close the western BPP trunk. The divider-spreading family is analytically exhausted (single card-3 and card-4 pairs both fail to reach 1.20 mm). Proceed to candidate_A (U18-pose / trunk-lane vacate sweep, c4) as the LAST placement-scope family before conceding to candidate_B.
